# KaTeX 0.19.0 (MIT)

Pinned ES module from the official npm package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/0.19.0
The downloaded tarball was checked against the registry SHA-512 integrity in `provenance.json` before extracting only `dist/katex.mjs` and `LICENSE`.
The build also checks the vendored module SHA-256. No install scripts were run.

Runtime uses local MathML output with `trust:false`, fresh macros per formula and expansion/size limits. No CDN, fonts or network request is needed. Unsupported or invalid input is shown verbatim.
Options and security: https://katex.org/docs/options and https://katex.org/docs/security
